blocks.imageAlt: Woven and knitted elastic tape rolls used for waistbands and cuffs
blocks.heading: Elastic That Still Recovers After The Hundredth Wash
blocks.html:
An elastic tape that stretches well off the roll but goes slack after a season of washing hasn't done its job — it's simply failed slower. We manufacture woven and knitted elastic tape built around recovery, not just initial stretch, so a waistband holds its grip and a cuff holds its shape through the full working life of the garment.

Woven and knitted construction serve different jobs: woven elastic holds a firmer, more stable width for structured waistbands, while knitted elastic gives a softer hand and better stretch-in-both-directions for cuffs and close-to-skin applications. We produce both, so you're not forced to compromise one job for the other.

blocks.heading: Woven & Knitted Elastics FAQs
blocks.intro: Don't see your question here? Ask us directly and we'll respond within one business day.

items.q: Should I use woven or knitted elastic for my garment?
items.a: Woven elastic holds a firmer, more stable width and suits structured waistbands. Knitted elastic has a softer hand and stretches in both directions, which suits cuffs and close-to-skin applications. Tell us your garment and we'll recommend the right construction.

items.q: What widths do you supply as standard?
items.a: We keep standard widths that cover the most common waistband, cuff and innerwear applications, and can cut custom widths on confirmed bulk orders. Share your target width and we'll confirm feasibility.

items.q: What is the minimum order quantity?
items.a: Minimum quantities depend on construction, width and colour. Share your requirement through our contact form and we'll confirm feasible order sizes and lead time.

items.q: Does the elastic hold recovery after repeated washing?
items.a: Our elastic is manufactured for stretch recovery across repeated wash cycles, not just off the roll. For institutional or high-wash-frequency use, let us know so we can confirm the most suitable grade.

blocks.heading: Need Woven Or Knitted Elastic In Bulk?
blocks.text: Tell us the construction, width and quantity you need — our team will respond with pricing and lead time within one business day.
